correctness.rationale: Beta monomial norms for weight (1-|z|)^t, t>-1, and normalization by K_t(0,0) yield coefficients d_n=(t+3)_{2n}/(2n+1)!, with locally normal convergence for all complex t and |z wbar|<1. Fourier-mode testing on circles makes Hermitian PSD equivalent to all coefficient signs nonnegative. For nonintegral t<-3 the count of negative factors is q=ceil(-t-3), and 2n-factor prefixes yield positivity iff q even. Integer t=-k (k>=3) truncates at 2n>=k-2 with exactly floor((k-1)/2) positive coefficients/rank; all other admitted interiors have strictly positive coefficients and infinite rank by Vandermonde. Independent signs of coefficients in multiple bands/gaps and integer ranks k=3..21 checked; limits t=-1,-2 are continued normalized series, not actual integrable weights.
